The structure of Ca2Tm2S4 (CaTmS2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 16-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ca and Tm 8-vertex polyhedra, corner-sharing between Ca 8-vertex and S 9-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between S 9-vertex polyhedra.
